scenarios.scenario: Execute a real coding run through the Gate 3 sandbox and prove project commands remain isolated from the host.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack, Temporal worker, sandbox service and container engine
preconditions: The sealed Gate 4 implementation rebuilt the worker and sandbox images.
execution: Run the coding scenario and inspect session, engine, identity, sentinel and cleanup observations.
expected: All project commands execute inside the no-network sandbox and leave the host unchanged.
observed: The sealed scenario passed 27/27 observations in one released no-network session with the host sentinel unchanged.

scenarios.scenario: Reproduce a passing run from stored inputs under the same frozen plan while preserving a distinct run identity.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack with Temporal, PostgreSQL, MinIO, sandbox service and container engine
preconditions: A complete passing quality run and immutable evidence exist.
execution: Request reproduction and compare plan, lineage, results and verdicts.
expected: The reproduced run has a distinct identity and an equivalent outcome without rewriting the original.
observed: The sealed scenario preserved plan identity and lineage while reproducing all seven results and the PASS verdict.

scenarios.scenario: Restart the evaluator worker during an active quality run and observe exactly-once recovery.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack with Temporal evaluator worker, PostgreSQL, MinIO and sandbox service
preconditions: A slow quality run is active with a durable identity.
execution: Restart the evaluator worker and inspect the terminal run and stored results.
expected: The same run resumes, records each result once and releases its sandbox.
observed: The sealed scenario reached SUCCEEDED with seven unique results, preserved identity and no active sandbox.

scenarios.scenario: Cancel one active quality run and allow another to exceed its policy-owned deadline.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack with Temporal, evaluator, sandbox service and container engine
preconditions: Slow quality fixtures are available in the built quality image.
execution: Cancel one run, execute one timeout, and inspect cleanup, results, evidence and verdicts.
expected: Both paths terminate after cleanup and derive FAIL without accepting late or contradictory work.
observed: The sealed cancellation and timeout scenarios both passed their complete fail-closed observations.

scenarios.scenario: Run passing and deliberately failing fixtures through the same complete Quality Engine path.
scenarios.environment: real Compose stack with Temporal, PostgreSQL, MinIO, sandbox service and container engine
preconditions: Passing and failing fixtures are present in the built image.
execution: Execute both fixtures and inspect the complete result, finding, evidence and verdict sets.
expected: Only the complete successful set derives PASS; the deliberate defect derives FAIL.
observed: The sealed scenarios preserved seven evidence-backed results and truthful PASS/FAIL verdicts.

scenarios.feature: Canonical IACode evaluation and false-PASS rejection
scenarios.scenario: Evaluate IACode under its canonical profile and execute the required adversarial battery over a valid null control.
scenarios.environment: current IACode source, rebuilt evaluator image and real Compose stack
preconditions: The canonical policy and IACode snapshot are frozen.
execution: Inspect the sealed IACode evaluation and execute the current A-Q Red Team battery.
expected: The canonical verdict is truthful and every mandatory mutation is defended.
observed: The sealed IACode evaluation passed; current command cmd-0017 defended 17/17 attacks with a valid control.

scenarios.scenario: Send a canonical scanner-detected synthetic marker under an ordinary structured output key through record_execution.
scenarios.environment: rebuilt evaluator image with in-memory object and metadata stores
preconditions: The marker is assembled only in memory and the unmutated verdict control is valid.
execution: Execute attack Q through the exact activity-to-store path and derive the run verdict.
expected: No evidence object or metadata row is created, the result is sanitized ERROR and the verdict is FAIL.
observed: Command cmd-0017 observed ERROR, FAIL, zero objects, zero records and no prohibited bytes in result or verdict.
